datasets.name: DataCo Global Supply Chain Dataset
datasets.usage_restrictions: Commercial and research use permitted with attribution

target_definitions.delay_risk_label: 1 if actual shipping duration exceeds scheduled shipping duration by tolerance threshold; 0 otherwise

datasets.known_biases_and_limitations: Historical records skewed towards specific Latin American and North American trade routes; lacked continuous cold-chain temperature telemetry.

datasets.name: WHO Cold Chain Monitoring Guidelines & Temperature Telemetry Benchmark
datasets.repository: World Health Organization Technical Report Series
datasets.usage_restrictions: Educational and research reference for temperature safety standards

target_definitions.temperature_quality_risk_label: 0 if strictly within threshold; 1 if moderate excursion without permanent degradation; 2 if critical stability breach

datasets.known_biases_and_limitations: Laboratory and field survey data focused primarily on vaccines (+2°C to +8°C and -20°C); does not encompass perishables or dry ambient electronics.

datasets.name: TrustTrace High-Fidelity Physics & Sensor Telemetry Simulator
datasets.usage_restrictions: Explicitly labelled as synthetic_simulated for college/hackathon demonstration and robust stress-testing

target_definitions.delay_risk_label: Ground truth binary indicator of delivery delay relative to planned schedule
target_definitions.temperature_quality_risk_label: Ordinal risk score (0: Normal, 1: Excursion Warning, 2: Critical Excursion/Quality Risk)

datasets.known_biases_and_limitations: Synthetic distributions modeled on real-world physics but subject to generative assumptions regarding weather severity and carrier variance.
